description: TPS22948DCKR current-limited reverse-blocking load switch; SC-70-6
name: tps22948dckr
watch_out_for: IN1 GND2 ON3 NC4 FLT5 OUT6. Supply 2.5-5.5 V, rated 130 mA. Shutdown current <=5 uA is specified at VIN=5 V, ON low, OUT grounded, -40..125 C; do not extrapolate this bound to 3.3 V. Switching times are typical, not guaranteed maxima. TI recommends 1 uF input bypass and 18 nF at OUT. Land pattern corrected against TI DCK0006A; electrical pin types reviewed.
